products.title: Introduction of Product Series
products.body_html:
Welcome to Steadywin! Here is an brief introduction to our company's five product lines. Hope it can be helpful.

All products are Brushless Direct Current (BLDC) Motors.

1. Frameless Motor    Frameless Outrunner Motor Selection Table
    Frameless motors comprise only the stator and rotor assembly.

2. Gimbal Motor   Gimbal Motor Selection Table
    Frameless Motor + Housing = Gimbal Motor
    A Gimbal Motor ( BLDC Motor) is built from a frameless motor core. It is designed to be used with an encoder and requires an external driver (e.g., SDC300). Typical applications include camera gimbals, rotating LiDAR, small UAV pods, and precision rotary tables.

3. Direct Drive Motor   Brushless Direct Drive Motor Selection Table
    Gimbal Motor + Driver Board = Direct Drive Motor
    Direct Drive Motors feature an integrated driver and encoder. They incorporate a semi-hollow shaft design, allowing for cable pass-through. Primary applications include LiDAR, gimbals, electro-optical pods, SCARA arms, and AGVs.

4. Planetary Gear Motor   Planetary Reduction Motor Selection Table
    Planetary Gear Motor (Integrated Joint Module) integrates a BLDC motor, a planetary gearhead, an encoder, and a drive into a single compact unit. It supports closed-loop control for position, velocity, and torque. It is widely used in robotic joints, collaborative robot arms, AGV drives, and UAV winches.

5. Exoskeleton Motor
    Exoskeleton Motors employ a specialized hand-winding technique to achieve an exceptionally high slot fill factor. They are specifically engineered for military, industrial, and medical rehabilitation exoskeletons, delivering robust and reliable auxiliary power.

Q&A

Q 1 : What's the difference between GDZ468/GDZ468H driver and GDS6 driver?

A : The GDZ468 or GDZ468H driver board supports three communication protocols: CAN, 485, and Modbus,
while the GDS6 drive board supports CAN communication.

Q 2 : What's the difference between GDZ468 driver and GDZ468H driver?

A : The only difference between GDZ468 and GDZ468H is that the operating voltage range of GDZ468 is 12-40V, while the operating voltage range of GDZ468H is 12-52V.

Q 3 : What's the function of the secondary encoder?

A: The sole function of the secondary encoder is to remember the single-turn position after a power loss. 【 not to mitigate the backlash】
